chapter.verse: Topa ka Pasian aw, nang kong bel hi; kei hong delhte khempeuh kiang panin hong gum in la hong hon in.
Hong hon kei lecin, hong hon ding dang om lo ahih manin amaute in humpinelkai bangin hong kaikhia-in hong balgawp ding uh hi.
Topa ka Pasian aw, hih bangin ka gamtat a siat a, ka khut a khialh leh,
thu om lopi-in ka lawmte kheemin, ka galte ka huh tak leh,
galte in delhin hong pha hen la, lei lakah kei hong tuancilsak in la, leilak ah hong sialpai ta hen.
Tho in, Topa, hehsa-in thasaan in la, ka galte’ hehna hong dal in; khanglo in, ka Pasian aw, thukhen nading khat na seh khin zo hi.
Mite nangma kim-ah kikhawmsak in la, amau tung a san’na munah tu in.
Topa in mite thukhen hi; Topa aw, ka thumanna leh ka sunga om keima dikna tawh kizui-in thu hong khen in.
Lungsim leh ngaihsutna a en a thuman Pasian aw, migilote’ siatna beisak in la, mi thumante kipsak in.
Pasian in kei hong hupa hi a, lungsim thutang mite a hon hi.
Pasian in a tang-a thu khenpa hi a, ni sim-a heh den Pasian ahi hi.
Mi in a kibawl phat kik kei leh, Pasian in a thalkhau suui zo a, a namsau taat ding hi.
Amah in mei thaltang bawl a, sih theihna ama galhiamte a baihsa-in koih zo hi.
Migilo in thusia gai-in suak nuamin na a, zuauthu hing khia hi.
Amah in gum to-in, ama tawhsa gum sung mah ah amah kia hi.
Ama lungngaih hoih lo pen ama lu tungah tungkik a, ama gamtatsia pen ama luzang mah ah tu hi.
Ke’n ahih leh, ama dikna om bangin Topa tungah lungdamna ka lak ding a, a Sangpen Topa min, phatna la ka sak ding hi.
